body: First full-episode (not just cold-open) GPT-2-assisted render experiment. Seeded from the S01E02 experiment's own emergent output line rather than an existing script -- a render seeding a new render. Same 5-call ramp (16/32/64/128/256 max_tokens, ~11 min, 17:44-17:55). Final pass fabricated a complete archival citation format with two named witnesses (KINGSTON, JOHN / DREIFER, PAUL) and a Kennedy/Johnson/Vietnam conflation against the WWII seed -- built the episode's actual plot around investigating that fabrication, explicit in-text that the names are verified against nothing because there's nothing to verify them against. Placed as Series X unnumbered (x05), documentary-crew format (not the RED GARDEN garage format), explicitly scoped to not touch Season 6's Hastings Street/Constructions continuity. Not promoted to canon. TYLER commit 587fa4c.
title: TYLER: x05 'The Only Airplanes Are Buses' — full episode, third GPT-2 render experiment
